# The appointments Odùduwà made — and who is keeping them

One myth is a story. A cycle of myths is a specification. Read Odùduwà's cycle in order and the industries fall out of it one by one.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Odùduwà
- **Pantheon:** Yoruba
- **Domain of influence:** Progenitor, Ile-Ife, First King
- **Pattern seats:** 7
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Commerce & Governance · Culture & Entertainment · Technology & Innovation · Home & Lifestyle
- **Strongest seat:** Faith & Spiritual Organizations
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 353 of 546

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations — through *Seventeen from Ọ̀run*

In the beginning the world was water: Olódùmarè, the supreme God, ruled from Ọ̀run, the sky, while Ayé, the earth below, was soft marsh without a place to stand.  The orishas petitioned to build a dry world, and Olódùmarè chose Ọbàtálá — Oríṣàńlá, the most senior among them — to lead the mission down, with Odùduwà in the company: in some tellings his younger brother, in others simply the keeper of the god's bag of materials.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The primordial ancestor and earth-creator of the Yoruba; his shrine at Ilé-Ifẹ̀ is a living pilgrimage center.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. That is the cycle working: story becomes duty, duty becomes trade.

### Ancestry & Heritage Services — through *The Sleep of Ọbàtálá*

Before the descent, Ọbàtálá grew thirsty and drank palm wine — and the wine dulled him.  He staggered, fell, and slept beside the work he had been sent to do.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The primordial ancestor of the Yoruba people; every royal lineage in Ilé-Ifẹ̀ traces descent from him.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Mythic Name Restoration — through *Where the World Began*

The spot where Odùduwà landed and made his camp became Ilé-Ifẹ̀ — the name is usually explained as 'the house of expansion' (ifẹ̀, breadth).  Here he planted his staff and raised the first city; from here the world was peopled and the kingship of the earth was administered.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Yoruba origin ancestor whose tones and underdot belong to the name.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. Industries do not invent their archetypes; they inherit them and call them best practice.

### Diacritic-First Domains — through *The Kings Go Out*

From Ifẹ̀, kingship radiated outward.  Ifẹ̀ tradition names seven sons of Odùduwà who went out from the city to become kings of the Yoruba towns, the royal lines of the entire people descending from this single household; the youngest, Ọ̀rànmíyàn, was the heir who stayed at home longest and set out last of all.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Grave tones and underdot make Òdùduwà faithful to Yoruba orthography.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. That is the cycle working: story becomes duty, duty becomes trade.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

Odùduwà's story is the Yoruba Genesis: the descent from heaven, the making of dry land, the founding of Ilé-Ifẹ̀, and the fathering of dynasties. It lives in the Ifá corpus and in oral tradition rather than any fixed book, and the tellings disagree with one another — the tradition itself treats the variants as paths to the same city.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

The atlas is not a horoscope. Seats are earned from the sources — argued, weighted, published — and every one of them can be challenged at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). A match that cannot survive an argument does not survive review. That is the whole trick: the patterns are claims, and claims can be tested.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in faith & spiritual organizations, ancestry & heritage services, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/oduduwa/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
